items.title: Bottle cap
items.fact: The bottle cap is the main currency used in the Mojave Wasteland when dealing with NPCs.

items.title: Space suit
items.fact: It is classified as light armor and can be repaired with radiation suits. It also has a high radiation resistance.

items.title: Mirelurk queen
items.fact: They can also release mirelurk spawn like grenades, using them as a distraction while she kills the opponent.

items.title: Centaur
items.fact: Centaurs are approximately the size of a small bear, with a large, misshapen torso and six humanoid arms that serve as legs.

items.title: Super sledge
items.fact: The super sledge's main advantages are its large damage output and long reach, capable of killing most common enemies, such as feral ghouls and raiders, in one or two swings.

items.title: Blue Ridge Caravan Company
items.fact: The Blue Ridge Caravan Company is a powerful merchant company operating on the East Coast, and a major faction.

items.title: Railway rifle
items.fact: The gun fires railway spikes as crude flechettes, making a distinctive "toot-toot" noise after each shot like a train whistle.

items.title: Robobrain
items.fact: Most pre-War robobrains carry sniper rifles and assault rifles, although units with City-Killer combat shotguns were also sighted.

items.title: Chairmen
items.fact: The Chairmen are one of the Three Families on the New Vegas Strip in the Mojave Wasteland in 2281.

items.title: Bill of Rights
items.fact: The Bill of Rights is an item encountered during the quest Stealing Independence.

items.title: Acid
items.fact: Acid is an uncommon component that is primarily used in chemistry stations for smelting ore and crafting unrefined gunpowder.

items.title: Gauss rifle
items.fact: The Gauss rifle is able to deliver very high damage after being fired when fully charged.

items.title: 10mm round
items.fact: A medium caliber, high velocity auto-pistol round manufactured before the Great War.

items.title: Baseball uniform
items.fact: The baseball uniform and baseball cap are an outfit in Fallout 4.

items.title: Plasma gun
items.fact: The plasma gun is a versatile urban warfare weapon that can be used as a pistol, sniper rifle, semi-auto rifle, assault rifle, shotgun or even a flamethrower…

items.title: Skylanes Air
items.fact: Skylanes Air was an airline carrier that was known to operate in the United States before the Great War.

items.title: T-65 power armor
items.fact: The armor offers the highest flat physical resistance out of any power armor in the game (although the Hellcat power armor still provides greater physical damage reduction).

items.title: State of Utobitha
items.fact: The State of Utobitha is a remnant group of first and second generation super mutants led by Tabitha in the Mojave Wasteland in 2281.

items.title: Angler
items.fact: The most powerful angler variant, distinguished by its green radioactive glow.

items.title: Flamer
items.fact: It is also considered an energy weapon instead of a big gun as in Fallout 3.

items.title: RadAway
items.fact: Because RadAway's base effect is exactly 50, it will always remove 50 + skill rads; every skill level of Medicine is relevant to it.

items.title: Nuka-Cola Clear formula
items.fact: The formula describes how to make Nuka-Cola Clear, a type of Nuka-Cola that was invented shortly before the Great War but never mass-produced.

items.title: Mechanist's armor
items.fact: The armor provides a Damage Resistance of 72 as well as an Energy Resistance 72, increases the Sole Survivor's Endurance by 1 and also reduces the damage the player character takes from robots by 15%.

items.title: Flower
items.fact: A Unity Rose, simply called a flower in the inventory, is a miscellaneous item in Fallout.

items.title: Mister Handy
items.fact: Mister Handy is a robot found around New California in Fallout 2.

items.title: Regulators
items.fact: In 2158, Jon Zimmerman hired mercenaries that displaced the original Regulators.

items.title: The Ghoul's coat
items.fact: It provides wearers with +2 Perception, +2 Endurance, +2 Charisma, and +2 Agility.

items.title: Gannon family Tesla armor
items.fact: The Gannon family Tesla armor is classified as medium armor.

items.title: New California Republic
items.fact: The New California Republic (NCR) is a post-War federal republic founded in the namesake territory of New California in 2189.

items.title: Vodka
items.fact: Vodka, as well as other hard liquor, provides a boost of +1 to Strength and Charisma but also gives a penalty of -1 to Intelligence.

items.title: Power armor frame
items.fact: The power armor frame is the basic exoskeleton unit required for all power armor models in Fallout 4.

items.title: Mole rat
items.fact: Mole rats are creatures found in the Capital Wasteland in 2277.

items.title: Grenade rifle
items.fact: A break-action single-shot explosive weapon chambered for 40mm grenades.

items.title: Sensor module
items.fact:
It is used in the construction of the following items: 
- Bottlecap mine
- Powder charge 
- Fat Mine 
- Gas bomb 
- Auto-inject stimpak 
- Auto-inject super stimpak 
- Satchel charge…

items.title: Elite riot gear
items.fact: The elite riot gear and elite riot gear helmet are a unique set of armor.

items.title: Blade of the East
items.fact: The weapon is used by Legate Lanius in the Legate's camp, but can only be obtained from him if one is siding with the NCR, Mr. House, or Yes Man…

items.title: T-51b power armor
items.fact: Grafton Steel attempted to create their own variant, codenamed Project Phoenix, resulting in a helmet reaching the prototype stage before the war.

items.title: Giant ant
items.fact: Giant ants are creatures found in the Capital Wasteland in 2277.

items.title: Enclave remnants
items.fact: The Enclave remnants are a unit of surviving Enclave soldiers who have entered the Commonwealth in 2287 to track down and recover the X-02 power armor stolen by a deserter known as the Black Devil.

items.title: Poseidon Oil
items.fact: Poseidon Oil was a subsidiary of Poseidon Energy before the Great War.

items.title: Stingwing
items.fact: Stingwings are flying creatures in the Commonwealth in 2287.

items.title: Hellcat Company
items.fact: The Hellcat Company is a mercenary faction in the wasteland, with known operations in the Pitt and Appalachia.

items.title: Buffout
items.fact: The addiction effects are -1 Strength and -1 Endurance once Buffout has worn off.

items.title: Jet pack
items.fact: The jet pack allows the wearer to propel into the air at the cost of AP.

items.title: Nuka-Girl rocketsuit
items.fact: The outfit is located in the Galactic Zone park in Nuka-World, found on a mannequin within the Nuka-Galaxy ride.

items.title: Strangler heart power armor
items.fact: A set of Ultracite power armor that has been completely overrun by strangler vines and other flora.

items.title: Naughty nightwear
items.fact: When equipped, the outfit does not grant any Damage Threshold but does grant +10 Speech and +1 Luck.

items.title: Rivet City security force
items.fact: The Rivet City security force is almost entirely comprised of citizens in good standing, who know how to handle firearms.

items.title: Mole rat
items.fact: Mole rats are creatures found in the Mojave Wasteland in 2281.

items.title: Sweet roll
items.fact: A post-War dessert, sweet roll restores 20 Hit Points, but increases Radiation by 4.

items.title: Gauss rifle
items.fact: The weapon's damage is determined by the amount of charge it has, with no charge resulting in the listed weapon damage and full charge, a little over three times.

items.title: Super-Duper Mart
items.fact: Super-Duper Mart was a pre-War retail corporation that operated a chain of grocery stores and supermarkets.

items.title: Westside Cooperative
items.fact: The Westside Cooperative is a farming commune and leadership council operating within the community of Westside in the Mojave Wasteland in 2281.

items.title: Grafton Monster
items.fact: It stands around 7.5 feet (2.3 meters) tall and has an oversized chest.

items.title: Legion denarius
items.fact: Legion denarius can be found on most members of Caesar's Legion, with even low-level recruit legionaries carrying as many as 15.

items.title: Soil Stradivarius
items.fact: After she was invited to enter Vault 92, a vault purportedly dedicated to preserving musical talent, Hilda took the Stradivarius with her inside.

items.title: Yao guai
items.fact: Yao guai are extremely fast and powerful creatures, second only to deathclaws in terms of raw strength and speed.

items.title: Cassidy Caravans
items.fact: Cassidy Caravans is a caravan company founded, owned, and led by Rose of Sharon Cassidy that operates in New California and the Mojave Wasteland.

items.title: Crowbar
items.fact: As well as a weapon it enables the prying open of locked containers and stuck doors (through the "Use Inventory Item On" command).

items.title: Trog
items.fact: Trogs are heavily deformed humans who have been mutated by the radiation and toxic pollutants from the many factories in Pittsburgh.

items.title: Power fist
items.fact: This pre-War model of the power fist was originally used by construction crews for demolition.

items.title: Mini nuke
items.fact: Developed at Fort Strong as part of the M42 Fat Man project, the mini nuke is one of the most powerful conventional weapons ever devised.

items.title: Pip-Boy 2000 Mark VI
items.fact: Each Vault Dweller leaving Vault 76 was issued a Mark VI to assist in their goal of rebuilding Appalachia 25 years after the Great War.

items.title: Submariner uniform
items.fact: The uniform and hat are worn by Captain Zao in the Yangtze, and can be looted from him or pickpocketed off of him.

items.title: Acadia
items.fact: Acadia is the name given to the isolated colony of synths led by the prototype synth DiMA residing on Mount Desert Island in Maine in 2287, so-named after the pre-War observatory they inhabit.

items.title: Wood
items.fact: Moe Cronin in Diamond City sells shipments of 100 units of wood.

items.title: Benny's suit
items.fact: The outfit is worn by Benny, leader of the Chairmen, initially found on the main floor of the Tops casino at the New Vegas Strip during the main quest Ring-a-Ding-Ding!.

items.title: .50 cal machine gun
items.fact: The M2 Browning machine gun is a belt-fed automatic heavy weapon chambered for.50 caliber rounds.

items.title: Covenant
items.fact: The Covenant settlement is the culmination of her research, a prosperous community that is designed to attract dozens of visitors each week…

items.title: Lying, Congressional Style
items.fact: Reading this book permanently increases the Lone Wanderer's Speech skill by 1 (2 with Comprehension).

items.title: Sorrows
items.fact: The Sorrows' culture is one of grace and communion with their natural environment, rather than a warrior-based one, though they are not completely pacifistic.

items.title: Doctor's bag
items.fact: A leather bag containing the tools used by a physician to heal crippled limbs, serving this purpose in both normal and hardcore modes.

items.title: Tunnel Snakes
items.fact: The Tunnel Snakes were a juvenile delinquent gang active in Vault 101 in the Capital Wasteland.

items.title: Hologram
items.fact: They can be "destroyed" only by destroying or disabling their respective emitter. They can alternatively be reprogrammed to patrol different layers of the casino.

items.title: Wilson Atomatoys
items.fact: Wilson Atomatoys was a pre-War toy manufacturer that made the popular Giddyup Buttercup toys.

items.title: Vera's outfit
items.fact: Vera's outfit is a semi-unique piece of clothing in the Fallout: New Vegas add-on Dead Money.

items.title: Power fist
items.fact: The power fist can successfully strike about 500 times from full condition before breaking.

items.title: Mutant hound
items.fact: These are dogs that have undergone major mutations from being exposed to the Forced Evolutionary Virus. Usually, they are accompanying super mutants.

items.title: Buttercup toy
items.fact: Given by Arlen Glass as a reward for bringing him Marlene's holotape from Arlen's office at Wilson Atomatoys corporate HQ.

items.title: Bighorner
items.fact: Bighorners are mutated bighorn sheep native to the American Southwest.

items.title: Ranger outfit
items.fact: The ranger outfit consists of a light tan shirt tucked into green shorts, as well as tied brown shoes.

items.title: Tunneler
items.fact: They evolved into quadrupedal predators that lived and bred beneath the sands of the Divide.

items.title: Hardened Gauss rifle
items.fact: The hardened Gauss rifle is an improved coil gun featured in Fallout Shelter that fires shards of metal at high speeds using magnetic coils that are powered by microfusion cells.

items.title: Angler
items.fact: Anglers' energy resistance is much higher than their damage resistance, making ballistic or melee weapons the preferable choice for engaging them in combat.

items.title: Giant mantis
items.fact: Giant mantises (Mantis religiosa) are mutated insects found in the Mojave Wasteland and Zion Canyon in 2281.

items.title: Pittsburgh Union
items.fact: The Union was a group of industrious survivors largely descended from the pre-War Pittsburgh Union Local 42.

items.title: BlamCo Mac & Cheese
items.fact: It restores 5 hit points but also increases the player character's radiation level by 3 rads.

items.title: Sheriff's duster
items.fact: The sheriff's duster and sheriff's hat are pieces of clothing.

items.title: Lucy's vault suit
items.fact: It provides wearers with +3 Perception, +2 Endurance, and +3 Luck.

items.title: Hermit crab
items.fact: They utilize vans as a stand-in for their shell, such as those bearing Lobster Grill logos.

items.title: Declaration of Independence
items.fact: The Declaration of Independence is an item found in the ruins of D.C's National Archives.

items.title: Think tank
items.fact: Sometime following the bombs dropping, the project succeeded in transplanting the brains of the executives, now called the "Think Tank" and their robotic shells sharing that name.

items.title: Gatling plasma
items.fact: The Gatling plasma is a heavy weapon and fires very rapidly with relatively poor accuracy.

items.title: Gatling gun
items.fact: A number of Mothman cultists in the Mothman Equinox event are armed with Gatling guns, and may drop the weapon upon death.

items.title: Deathclaw gauntlet
items.fact: The deathclaw gauntlet is a crafted Unarmed weapon in Fallout 3.

items.title: T-45d power armor
items.fact: Equipping the T-45d power armor provides a Damage Threshold of 22 as well as a bonus of +10 Radiation Resistance and a temporary +2 to Strength and -2 to Agility.

items.title: Gorilla
items.fact: The gorilla is a synthetic creature found contained inside the terrariums of Institute BioScience in 2287.

items.title: Gatling laser
items.fact: It has a high rate of fire but low accuracy, and its automatic reloading behavior can lead to an inventory full of partially-used cores if frequently swapping between weapons.

items.title: Diehards
items.fact: In Wastelanders, they returned under the leadership of Meg Groberg.

items.title: Power fist
items.fact: However, like the previous designs, the power fist also uses a pneumatic battering ram to deliver powerful, medium-speed punches to attackers, releasing a puff of steam and sparks with each punch.

items.title: Ranger outfit
items.fact: Per their names, the Ranger outfits are typically worn by NCR Rangers around the Mojave Wasteland.

items.title: Protectron
items.fact: Protectrons are robots found in the Mojave Wasteland and at Big MT in 2281.

items.title: Maria
items.fact: A custom model of the M&A 9mm pistol made by M&A Guns Manufacturers, Maria is the personal firearm of the leader of the Chairmen, Benny.

items.title: Dead Horses
items.fact: The Dead Horses appear only in the Fallout: New Vegas add-on Honest Hearts.

items.title: Spray n' Pray
items.fact: Spray n' Pray is a legendary submachine gun sold by Cricket, or by other merchants (very rarely).

items.title: Spoiled vegetables
items.fact: A more practical use for the spoiled vegetable is to convert it into raw fertilizer at a chemistry station, at a rate of 10 spoiled vegetables for one raw fertilizer.

items.title: Chinese jumpsuit
items.fact: The Chinese jumpsuit and the Chinese commando hat are pieces of clothing in Fallout 3.

items.title: Vault jumpsuit
items.fact: It provides a Damage Resistance of 1 as well as a bonus of +2 to Speech and Melee Weapons, and can be repaired with other vault jumpsuits.

items.title: Raider armor
items.fact: It has a Damage Resistance of +20%, which is lower than even the starting leather armor.

items.title: Fixin' Things
items.fact: Reading this magazine raises Repair skill by 10 points (20 points with the Comprehension perk) for 60 seconds (180 seconds with Retention).

items.title: Handmade rifle
items.fact: The handmade rifle is a powerful weapon that fills a niche similar to the assault rifle.

items.title: Cultist
items.fact: These cultists are those who worship the Mothman, hostile to all outsiders intruding on their "holy land".

items.title: Combat shotgun
items.fact: The combat shotgun combines a large drum magazine with high close-range damage.

items.title: Vault jumpsuit
items.fact: All jumpsuits with the exception of those from Vault 11 have no Damage Threshold, but provide a bonus of +2 to Speech and Melee Weapons and can be repaired with other Vault jumpsuits.

items.title: Overseer's Guardian
items.fact: This weapon comes guaranteed with the Two Shot effect, which shoots an additional projectile with each shot.

items.title: Scout Handbook
items.fact: The Scout Handbook is a skill book that can permanently increase Outdoorsman in Fallout.

items.title: The Pack
items.fact: The hierarchy of the Pack is based on pop-cultural depictions of wolf packs, with their leader being referred to as the "alpha," they follow the rule of "survival of the fittest."

items.title: REPCONN Aerospace
items.fact: Their headquarters and test site can still be found in the Mojave Wasteland.

items.title: Mini nuke
items.fact: The mini nuke is a type of ammunition in Fallout: New Vegas.

items.title: RadAway
items.fact: The effectiveness of RadAway is dependent on the player character's Medicine skill, meaning that the higher the player character's Medicine skill, the more Rads are removed.

items.title: Anti-materiel rifle
items.fact: The anti-materiel rifle is a left-handed, bolt-action rifle that uses.50 caliber rounds.

items.title: Whiskey
items.fact: Whiskey is a consumable item. It increases Charisma and Strength and reduces Intelligence by 1.

items.title: Nuka-Cade ticket
items.fact: Used to buy items and weapons at the prize terminal located in the arcade.

items.title: Chainsaw
items.fact: A fully automatic melee weapon with sharp teeth able to shred virtually anything they come into contact with.

items.title: Mark of Caesar
items.fact: The item is a Legion denarius that has been turned into a necklace. It has a bull symbol and the words Legio Caesaris, Latin for Caesar's Legion.

items.title: Maxson's battlecoat
items.fact: This greatcoat is worn by Elder Arthur Maxson, leader of the East Coast Brotherhood of Steel in 2287.

items.title: Tesla rifle
items.fact: The Tesla rifle is a unique weapon in the Fallout 4 add-on Automatron, created by Ivey.

items.title: Nuka-Cola
items.fact: Nuka-Cola can be put into Drinkin' Buddy through the "I'll take a beer" dialogue option to produce ice cold Nuka-Cola 12 hours later, despite not being a beer.

items.title: Centaur
items.fact: Centaurs are the constant companions of super mutants and are used as their watchdogs.

items.title: Water Merchants
items.fact: The Water Merchants are a major caravan company operating out of the Hub in New California in 2161.

items.title: Circuitry
items.fact: A rare component used in high-tech mods, explosives, and chems, circuitry is essential for building turrets, camp defenses, and anywhere else where electronics are required.

items.title: Atom Cats
items.fact: The Atom Cats are a minor faction that draws inspiration from mid-1950s greasers, with leather outfits and a hotrod-themed paint job for their power armor.

items.title: Three Families
items.fact: While Securitrons patrol the exterior roads of the Strip, they can only enter a casino to handle official business if invited by the ruling Family.

items.title: Sentry bot
items.fact: Sentry bots are robots found in the Mojave Wasteland, Big MT and the Divide in 2281.

items.title: Slave collar
items.fact: Success in removing the collar is based on the player character's Science skill: one's skill must be at least 25 to attempt to remove the collar, with only a 50% chance of success.

items.title: Enclave paint
items.fact: The armor and Pip-Boy paint schemes have a matte black coloration with hints of yellow and a white Enclave logo.

items.title: Holy Hand Grenade
items.fact: Its real advantage over the frag grenade comes from the large increase of power and longer throwing distance.

items.title: Cazador
items.fact: Cazadores (Spanish for "hunters") are mutated insects found in the Mojave Wasteland, Big MT, and Zion Canyon in 2281.

items.title: Rust Eagles
items.fact: The Rust Eagles perfect their craft by pit fighting in the Metal Dome.

items.title: Heavy combat armor
items.fact: Heavy combat armor is a legendary outfit in Fallout Shelter.

items.title: A3-21 prototype rifle
items.fact: The A3-21 prototype rifle is a weapon in the Fallout 4 Creations content "Institute Plasma Weapons."

items.title: T-51f power armor
items.fact: The T-51f power armor is a legendary outfit in Fallout Shelter.

items.title: Antidote
items.fact: A bottle with a home-brewed antidote that counteracts poison, created out of a radscorpion tail.

items.title: Lad's Life
items.fact: Reading this magazine raises one's Survival skill by 10 points (20 points with the Comprehension perk) for 60 seconds (180 seconds with Retention).

items.title: Purified water
items.fact: Water purifiers will automatically produce purified water if powered in a camp.

items.title: Fragmentation grenade
items.fact: Almost every type of enemy can use these grenades, such as raiders, super mutants and Gunners.

items.title: Coyote
items.fact: Coyotes are creatures found in the Mojave Wasteland in 2281.

items.title: Diamond City security
items.fact: Diamond City security is the main security force of Diamond City in 2287.

items.title: Plasma pistol
items.fact: The plasma pistol is a powerful energy-based pistol, firing superheated bolts of green plasma.

items.title: Bloodbug
items.fact: Bloodbugs are a species of mutated, ectoparasitic mosquitoes found in the Commonwealth in 2287.

items.title: Radstag
items.fact: Radstags are the mutated descendants of the Commonwealth and the Island's local deer population in 2287.

items.title: Scorpion tail
items.fact: They are the tails taken from dead radscorpions, cut at the base where they meet the body, and they are prized for the poison sac it contains, which is used to make a poison antidote.

items.title: Mister Gutsy
items.fact: The Mister Gutsy is a combat model robot in the Capital Wasteland.

items.title: Sugar Bombs
items.fact: A pack of sugary cereal that holds 100% of the recommended daily amount of sugar, Sugar Bombs have been preserved for 25 years after the Great War.

items.title: Raiders
items.fact: Raiders are a type of faction, comprising multiple decentralized groups of nomadic bandits, outlaws, and thugs that occupy various locations throughout the Commonwealth.

items.title: Regulators
items.fact: The Regulators are a faction encountered in the Capital Wasteland.

items.title: ArcJet Systems
items.fact: ArcJet Systems (also known simply as ArcJet) was a pre-War company which performed communications and propulsion work for both military and civilian contractors as early as 2063.

items.title: Gauss rifle
items.fact: The Gauss rifle is an advanced sniper rifle included in the Fallout 3 add-on Operation: Anchorage.

items.title: Wasteland Survival Guide
items.fact: Reading this book permanently increases the Courier's Survival skill by 3 points (4 with the Comprehension perk).

items.title: Scorched Sierra power armor
items.fact: The scorched Sierra power armor is a suit of T-45d power armor that has been modified by the NCR for Colonel Royez.

items.title: Copper
items.fact: Copper is a component used to craft various electrical items, including weapon modifications, generators, lights, conduits and other settlement objects that require or produce power.

items.title: Chinese stealth armor
items.fact: The Chinese stealth armor is a light armor that grants the wearer a Sneak bonus of +5.

items.title: Lyons' Pride
items.fact: Lyons' Pride (commonly truncated as the Pride) is a special tactical unit within Lyons' Brotherhood of Steel, composed of elite Brotherhood soldiers led by Sentinel Sarah Lyons in 2277.

items.title: Flatwoods monster
items.fact: Flatwoods monsters, known before the War as the Green Monster, are extraterrestrial creatures encountered in Appalachia and expanded upon in the Invaders from Beyond update.

items.title: Publick Occurrences
items.fact: Publick Occurrences is a newspaper based in Diamond City in 2287, owned and operated by Piper Wright.

items.title: Enclave
items.fact: That year, this resurgent Enclave faction sent an expedition to the Commonwealth, seeking to recover any valuable materiel and establish a permanent base of operations in the region.

items.title: White Glove Society
items.fact: The White Glove Society is a former Vault tribe employed by Robert House to run and maintain the Ultra-Luxe casino and hotel.

items.title: Trog
items.fact: Trogs are creatures encountered by the Lone Wanderer in the Pitt.

items.title: Ranger battle armor
items.fact: The Ranger battle armor and matching Ranger battle helmet are pieces of armor worn by members of the mercenary group Reilly's Rangers.

items.title: Bloatfly
items.fact: Bloatflies are mutated insects living in the Mojave Wasteland, Zion Canyon, and Big MT in 2281.

items.title: Sheepsquatch
items.fact:
Sheepsquatches are creatures found in Appalachia. ## Background
A cryptid stalking the Appalachian mountains, the Sheepsquatch myth was an obsession for many cryptid hunters…

items.title: Minigun
items.fact: The minigun delivers an extremely high rate of fire, making it ideal for inflicting heavy damage on large quantities of relatively unarmored enemies.

items.title: Communist
items.fact: Communists are human combatants found at Camp Liberty in Appalachia.

items.title: Vault jumpsuit
items.fact: It is worn under armor and apparel and can be modded to increase Damage Resistance, Energy Resistance and Radiation Resistance.

items.title: Sugar Bombs
items.fact: In Fallout 3, Sugar Bombs are mildly useful food items found throughout the Capital Wasteland, which provide only a small amount of health when consumed.
